description: This PHP source file defines the AddressFormat controller in the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing address format configurations including listing, editing, creating, and deleting address formats within the admin interface.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations and views related to address formats in the OpenCart admin panel under the Localisation module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main address format list page, initializes page context and loads necessary components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the address format list, primarily delegating to getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches address format data, handles pagination, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address format creation/edit form, populates form data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles submission of address format data, performing validation, and saving to database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected address formats, with permission and dependency checks.
